terra.problem: Papa says he held a grudge, but he never holds a grudge.
The verse does not say that breaking faith excludes talking behind someone's back. The two could overlap.
Saying the LORD was there for the covenant adds a detail about when He witnessed it. The verse says He has been a witness between the man and his wife.
The verse does not say the LORD saw the covenant being made. It says He has been a witness between the man and his wife.
Calling the wife the one closest to him adds a claim the text does not make.
The claim that a cookie jar cannot buy what the verse is talking about adds an idea about buying godly offspring that the passage does not address.
The wallet joke has no clear connection to what the verse says and makes light of a passage about divorce and violence.
